name: 精密台账

referenceImages.role: Actual Fouc shell geometry, navigation, typography and material only; old dashboard contents replaced

prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: ONE high-fidelity screenshot of the Chinese Fouc desktop application WORKBENCH HOMEPAGE, concept “精密台账 / Precision ledger”.
Primary request: Create a mature, usable daily project homepage dominated by one broad precision work register. A sober professional software tool, extraordinarily clear alignment, quiet typographic hierarchy, visible real work and exact resumption actions. This is one flat front-on application screenshot at ordinary 100% desktop scale, approximately 1600 × 1000 pixels, NOT a presentation board or marketing graphic.

Input image 1 is a SHELL REFERENCE ONLY. Faithfully retain its actual Fouc navigation geometry, icon silhouettes, tabs, light shell material, footer and project switcher. REPLACE ALL old dashboard contents. Do NOT copy billing/invoice shortcuts, metric cards, team panel, timeline, meetings, progress charts or old example dates.

SHELL / SCALE: 1600×1000 screenshot. Fixed left sidebar 272px (17% width), #f9f9f9, NOT enlarged. 44px system title bar across top. Main white content surface starts x272 y44, extends to right and bottom with 16px outer corners and fine pale-gray border. Same small horizontal system controls and working-tab silhouette as reference: project icon and “Fouc 桌面端 V1” at upper left, project dropdown chevrons, collapse sidebar, history back/forward, active “工作台” tab and plus tab; far-right search, task icon, Windows minimize / maximize / close. Sidebar rows 30px, ordinary text13px, icons15px, no large empty nav gaps. Sidebar exact items “新对话”, selected neutral-gray “工作台”, “任务”, “成员”, “资产”, “智能体”; divider; “频道” with “产品与设计”; “最近” with “暂无最近对话”. Sidebar bottom “社区”, “连接器”, divider, user avatar “F”, “Fouc Admin”, moon and gear controls. Preserve reference FA7 solid icon silhouettes and neutral icon colors.

PAGE: cool-neutral white, ink #23262b, small graphite secondary text, ultra-fine horizontal rules #e5e8eb, strong column alignment. 13px body and controls, 12px metadata, tiny 11px monospaced FUC IDs and times, title only20px. Buttons30px high. No oversized text. No hero, no greeting. ONE page toolbar at y48–96, title “工作台” on left with small inline date “2026年11月12日 周四”; on right compact inline search affordance, filter, and black “＋ 新建工作” button. Do not add secondary filter/tabs/header bands. Useful work content starts y112. The title area must stay compact.

MAIN COMPOSITION: one wide organized work ledger with no surrounding card panel, no right-side inspector, no card grid, no second sidebar. Table spans entire inner main width, leaving 24px margins. Columns in precise baselines: “工作” (including tiny monospaced ID, title and subtle work-type), “当前活动”, “最新进展 / 下一步”, “负责人”, “更新”, and a right-aligned next-action column. Work-name column widest; all metadata aligns carefully. One 28px small table header. Flat horizontal rules, faint vertical separators only in header. Group heading “需要你跟进  2” with a tiny restrained amber dot; two corresponding rows. Then group heading “持续推进  4” and four rows. All six actual work rows visible. Each row approx48px, disciplined density and no large padding. Selected first row has the slightest cool-gray background and small black selection rail. Each row has compact status mark and a right aligned subtle action, monochrome except semantic status.

EXACT SIX WORK ROWS AND CONTENT:

1. “FUC-42” “成员邀请与权限” type “特性开发”; activity “详细设计”; latest/next “邀请重发规则待确认” followed by tiny amber “待你决定”; owner “林悦” with20px avatar; updated “10:42”; action “继续设计 ↗”. Under the context within the row show tiny muted “design.md v3 · ADR-012”. Selected row.

Group 持续推进:

6. “FUC-46” “项目活动摘要” type “文档工作”; activity “正文草稿”; latest/next “基于本周已确认的交付记录”; owner “林悦”20px avatar; updated “09:54”; action “继续编写 ↗”.

Below the register, separated by generous but normal24px gap, a lightweight full-width CONTEXTUAL RESUMPTION STRIP for the selected first work, not a card grid or editor. Small top line “继续上次工作” and tiny “FUC-42 / 成员邀请与权限”. Two-column reading WITHIN A SINGLE HORIZONTAL STRIP: left a clear modest16px text “确认邀请重发规则”, below one useful line “两个方案已备齐，继续查看设计中的开放决定。” Then inline tiny file-source pills with simple document icons: “design.md v3” and “ADR-012”. Right side a modest outlined “查看决定” action and secondary textual “打开工作 →”. Small amber “等待林悦确认” aligned nearby. Keep very light gray fill, ONE fine border, sharp12px corners, zero shadow, total height about130px. No approval checkbox, no bare homepage approve button, no full document excerpt, no editor toolbar.

Below, slim project-change ledger heading “项目更新” and exactly three tiny clean aligned rows, small neutral dots, timestamp right: “陈宁提交了连接器权限审计的 3 项发现” “Codex 补充了设备断连的复现记录” “林悦更新了成员邀请设计 v3”. Foot of table understated “当前项目 · 6 项工作” and small “查看全部工作 →” may be at table bottom, not another toolbar. Bottom breathing room is intentional, not a huge empty central gap. Total layout balanced down to y900.

VISUAL CRAFT: crisp Chinese system sans-serif like PingFang/SF/Inter, small digits in precise mono, exact baseline rhythm, all columns align, warm amber used only for two real human decisions, green only running state. Work type can have tiny understated semantic marks; global actions stay neutral. Flat very pale selected surfaces, single crisp borders, no shadows, no gradients, no oversized rounded pills. Current activity is NOT one of ten fixed columns, not a percentage. Human needs belong to the matching work rows, not a dashboard or right rail. Research and writing are visible equally as valid work.

Strictly do not include a workspace switcher, knowledge base, automation module, single-feature editor, code diff, chat panel, KPI wall, charts, decorative illustrations, huge command box, large greeting, title outside the app, variant labels, device frame, tilted perspective, collage, watermark or any old dashboard content from reference. Render readable Chinese exact text with meticulous professional software typography. This is a high quality finished normal-scale desktop project HOMEPAGE.
